# Geist font fixture

Official Google Fonts Geist v5 Latin WOFF2, with variable weights 400–700.
Frozen for browser tests of real font loading, embedded SVG fonts and PNG output.

- Source: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/geist/v5/gyByhwUxId8gMEwcGFU.woff2
- SHA-256: `19f9c92546aa300c312235e3125af1b81394d8db9a4bc4a425cd5b641d2d54e1`
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, included as `OFL.txt` from
  https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/geist/OFL.txt

The fixture is test-only and excluded from the published npm package. The SVGs
load this version from Google Fonts; the downloader embeds the font into each
exported SVG before producing either SVG or PNG output.
